evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Jeline: 'we can personalize your estimate here... this could take ten to fifteen minutes of your time. Is that okay?' — framed with time but no explicit 'quote you can depend on' language, and moved straight to next question without clear wait for yes.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Jeline: 'aside from the pricing do you have any other concerns about the moving process?' — asked after already collecting name, phone, email. Titisa: 'No, no, just I want to know the rate fee.' Customer raised only price concern, no additional concerns to probe.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — customer stated only pricing concern, no follow-up needed per rubric.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — customer raised no substantive concerns to reflect back.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Full coverage: pickup address (11008 Charville road, Apt 21078759), square footage (900 sq ft), bedrooms (2), floor/stairs (2nd floor, stairs only, 45 steps from stairs to unit), additional rooms (none), special items (couch with ottoman, 2 beds—king & queen, 6 luggage pieces, books, mixer, cooking items, show pieces), destination address (104-301-0430 Morado circle, Apt 1623), destination sq footage (1011), destination bedrooms (2), destination floor/stairs (2nd floor, stairs only, 8–9 steps from parking).
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Jeline: 'for a two bedroom apartment we 25 to 35 boxes. Do you think you would fall within that range?' Titisa confirmed 15–16 boxes total (including luggage and books).
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not asked. Jeline asked about items to be packed but never offered packing service.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Jeline: '$104 per hour per mover... two mover... $208... we do have a minimum of two and a half hours... estimate to move to be on the minimum of two and a half to three hours... estimated cost is between $520 to $624.' — Range given but not personalized to customer's specific concerns or prep level.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Jeline: 'hourly rate... $208 and everything is included... gas and truck taxes, insurance... wraps and pads... tools to disassemble and reassemble' — fee transparency present; 2.5-hour minimum mentioned but 'not a guess' framing and 15-minute-increments commitment not explicitly stated.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Jeline gave estimate and customer immediately asked 'Can you please send me the quotation in my email or text' — no 'does that feel fair' check and no pause held for reflection.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Not mentioned at any point in call.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: Not mentioned at any point in call.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No — neither promise was mentioned, so no loop to close.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Call moved directly from estimate to 'I'll be sending you an email' without a 'what's still concerning you' check.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No 'anything coming with you we haven't talked about' question.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Jeline said 'if you want to book with us... reply back to my email or give us a call' — soft, email-forward routing, not a direct 'Would you like our help with your move?' ask.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Jeline: 'We do not require any deposit' — addresses deposit policy but no explicit rate-lock/hold language.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Date confirmed (Monday, Oct 5th). Phone already collected. No explicit arrival window, crew size (2 movers mentioned but not confirmed as final), no addresses re-confirmed, no crew notes about customer concerns (none were deeply probed).

top_strength: Jeline gathered exceptionally thorough logistics details across both pickup and delivery locations—floor layouts, stair counts, distances, furniture inventory, special items, and bedroom counts—establishing a solid factual foundation for the estimate.
coaching_note: The call abandoned the sales structure after pricing: no 'Does that feel fair?' pause, no Two Promises, no final concerns check, and no explicit ask for the business. Recover Section 5 (On-Time + Damage) and Section 6 (final check) before moving to Section 7, and always ask 'Would you like our help with your move?' before offering email alternatives.
